title: Technical English — Course 5, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 1

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. When will the maintenance-planning lesson begin?
tasks.audioText: The aviation maintenance tutor will introduce maintenance planning records on Tuesday at nine. Students should meet in the documentation classroom and bring the sample work package. The lesson will identify task references, planned dates and required documentation. Students will discuss how a clear plan helps teams coordinate work, but no maintenance activity will be carried out.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. Which sample work package is needed for the planning exercise?
tasks.audioText: The aviation maintenance tutor will introduce maintenance planning records on Tuesday at nine. Students should meet in the documentation classroom and bring the sample work package. The lesson will identify task references, planned dates and required documentation. Students will discuss how a clear plan helps teams coordinate work, but no maintenance activity will be carried out.

tasks.prompt: A maintenance plan groups tasks that must be completed during a scheduled maintenance visit. It may identify the task reference, responsible team, expected duration and required documents. Planners also consider access to parts and specialist support. A clear plan does not replace the approved maintenance data; it helps the organisation coordinate work and record its progress. Reading 1. What may a maintenance plan identify?
options: Task reference, responsible team, expected duration and required documents

tasks.prompt: What does a clear plan help the organisation do?
The task references ___ in the maintenance plan.
Choose TWO details that support maintenance planning.
A collection of documents and task information for a maintenance visit is a work ___.
A task reference is missing from a work package. What should you ask?
options: I will invent a reference number.
Could we confirm the correct task reference in the approved maintenance documentation?
I will copy a number from another aircraft.

tasks.prompt: Put the stages of maintenance planning in a logical order.
options: Identify the task references and documents
correctOrder: Identify the task references and documents

tasks.prompt: Write 80–100 words explaining how a maintenance plan helps an aviation team coordinate tasks, documents and resources.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant content (0–2); clear organisation and logical linking (0–2); grammar and sentence structure (0–2); accurate maintenance vocabulary, spelling and punctuation (0–2). Minor errors are acceptable if meaning remains clear.
